rachel: Quick sync 1: planning to publish release post tomorrow 10am PT. Need one-line changelog, canonical docs link, short bench hero, webinar CTA, and lead-routing tag. Can eng confirm canary cadence and if any public caveats?

 diego: Canary plan: 10% at T+10m, 40% at T+45m, 100% at T+3h if health checks pass. Auto-rollback on sustained error_rate > 0.5% for 10m. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/712

 amy: Docs staging: https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/release-1.3. Examples updated to show batching_mode=adaptive. Need eng sign-off on the example responses.

 diego: Signed off on examples. Public caveat: first-request latency improves after KV warm-start; include a short note.

 deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @diego at 2024-06-14T17:00:00Z. Metrics: latency_p95, error_rate, token_cost.

 ben: Bench hero candidate: "p95 down ~19%, token cost down ~9%." Short enough for hero. I'll export the before/after graph to assets.

 maya: Webinar: Thu 11am ET confirmed. I'll add registration CTA to the blog. Lead routing: tag forms campaign=jun_release_1_3 and route HubSpot -> SFDC.

 rachel: Final asks: diego paste final changelog line; amy give canonical docs permalink; ben attach asset link. If all green, I'll lock publish 10am PT tomorrow.

 diego: Changelog line: "Enabled adaptive batching, improved KV cache warm-start for quicker first responses, and deployed a staged canary with auto-rollback on error spikes."

 amy: Canonical docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1.3. Examples verified on staging.

 ben: Graph uploaded: https://internal.redwood/assets/releases/1-3/p95-cost-compare.png

 rachel: Locking publish at 10am PT unless a blocker shows up. Thanks all :rocket:
